serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Annoying neighbor: What the hell dude, what do you want?
This guy… He made me wait all this time?! Motherfucker… 
His posture is similar to mine, but his skin is even whiter. First thing that comes to mind after looking at him is a cellar-dweller. 
He’s skinny and his eyes seem lifeless. Even I would probably destroy this guy in a fist fight… I think. I don’t know why, but I feel uncomfortable around him. He gives me the vibe of a sick animal. 
You: W-well, Your music is kinda loud, you know? Could you turn it down or something? 
Annoying neighbor:  Why would I?
You: Because it’s loud and it’s hella annoying man! Be more considerate, geez. 
Annoying neighbor: I like loud music and I want to listen to it more. If that’s all I’m going back to my room. 
You: Wait a second! There’s no way that I’m the only one here that has a problem with this! W-we will call the police on you! 
Annoying neighbor: Police? Please, be my guest. Checked the law lately? I’m not obliged to open my door to them. Besides… Even if they come here I will just go dark for a few minutes and the problem is solved. You’ve got nothing on me. 
What is he talking about? There is no way police can’t do anything about it, right?
Annoying neighbor: And you are right, you were not the only one who came to me today. Guy from the second floor even threatened me that he will blast me lol. 
Annoying neighbor: I just don’t care. I’m paying the landlord double only for him to shut the fuck up. You just gotta live with this from now on I guess.
You: You prick! Fucking weirdo! Just turn it down!
Annoying neighbor: Bye bye~
